purpose: I’m opening a second coffee shop kiosk inside a busy coworking building and need a practical agreement with the property owner / host operator. We’ll run espresso, drip coffee, pastries, bottled drinks, and light grab-and-go food from a small branded counter in their lobby. I need clear terms for rent or revenue share, utilities, water access, hours, storage space, deliveries, cleaning responsibilities, trash removal, maintenance for machines, internet/POS access, signage rights, exclusivity on coffee sales in the building, health code compliance, insurance, damage responsibility, security access, employee badges, parking/loading, data/privacy for customer Wi-Fi or loyalty programs, termination notice, renewal options, what happens if building traffic drops, and a fair process for disputes. I also want it easy for both sides to review changes together, collaborate on edits, and sign digitally once finalized.
title: Agreement
